Black & White series · NXD

Next Destinies

Released February 8, 2012 · 103 cards

Expanded

Next Destinies is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on February 8, 2012. Its main set has 99 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (103 in total). It includes 95 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

28 illustrators worked on Next Destinies. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (17), Naoki Saito (9), Ryo Ueda (7), Kouki Saitou (6), Shizurow (6), Akira Komayama (5), Mizue (5), Masakazu Fukuda (4).
